items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: A lot of those guys are here — Marty Grosz, Dan Barrett, Hal Smith is here.

ctx.x: Rick Fay is the leader on this. It’s called “This is Where I Came In” right? Arbors Records? Dan Barrett was on there and I think that was Dan Barrett’s arrangement, which was taken largely from one of Bix Beiderbecke’s versions of that song. And he did a lot of arrangements on that album. I think Marty Grosz did do some arrangements on that
album as well. A lot of those guys are here — Marty Grosz, Dan Barrett, Hal Smith is here.
